json_ld_descriptions: Top-rated personal injury attorneys in Las Vegas dedicated to helping you get the compensation you deserve. Free consultations available.

Prior to forming Willoughby Shulman Injury Lawyers, Eric Willoughby and Stephen Shulman worked together at one of Nevada’s largest personal injury law firms. While there they gained valuable experience dealing with all types of personal injury cases, and recovered tens of millions for their clients. However, with aspirations to build and run their own firm, Eric and Steve partnered to form Willoughby Shulman Injury Lawyers.

Willoughby Shulman Injury Lawyers formed with the goal of giving clients the strength and experience of a large law firm and the personalized, dedicated service only a small firm can provide. At Willoughby Shulman Injury Lawyers, from the first meeting to the resolution of their case, clients deal directly with the firm’s founders and not just assistants or associates. No matter the size of your case, we will provide personalized attention and compassionate legal service for every client. Unparalleled client service is our goal.

At Willoughby Shulman Injury Lawyers we also want to ensure a fair result for our client. At Willoughby Shulman Injury Lawyers, our no win/no fee arrangement means you will never pay legal fees unless we win your case. We also know that you are the one going through this difficult time not us. That’s why we guarantee that our attorneys’ fees will never be larger than what you receive from your settlement.
